_help: Website copy for each collection. Anything written here WINS over the spreadsheet's Collections sheet when you run `node tools/build-data.js`. To use the spreadsheet's text again, delete that line here. accent = periwinkle, lavender, pink, butter or mint. shape = fan, sprig, circle, palm, starburst, arch or leaf.
